result.summary: The main issue is the broken layout of the restaurant list/card at the bottom of the visible screen area, specifically the pizza restaurant card which is cut off and lacks identifying information.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card (pizza image) is partially cut off at the bottom of the screen, hiding the restaurant name, rating, and delivery information.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the scroll view container padding or the card layout to ensure full visibility of the bottom-most list items.

issues.description: The 'See all' text for the 'Popular right now' section is aligned with the bottom of the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' header instead of the top, which feels slightly misaligned visually.
issues.suggestion: Align the 'See all' link text with the top of the section title or ensure vertical centering within the header row.
